title: syringa reticulata subsp. amurensis
intro: Syringa reticulata subsp. amurensis, commonly known as Amur lilac, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The Amur lilac is known to provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the Amur lilac, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
